crossRefs.note: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together…
I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame…
Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge…
But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your…
For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts…
For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for…
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

translations.web: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
translations.bsb: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
translations.kjv: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
translations.asv: Let him give his cheek to him that smiteth him; let him be filled full with reproach.
